violations.requirement: The index must be in bounds (order < 3 for the neighbors array); otherwise calling it is undefined behavior.
violations.explanation: This is a pub safe fn. It passes the caller-supplied `order` straight to `get_unchecked` with no bounds check. Any `order >= 3` from safe code causes an out-of-bounds read.
